kaleja chhatra kimora prati somabara, budhabara o shukrabare tinati 1-ghantara klasa thake. prati mangalabara o brihaspatibare, tara duti 2-ghantara klasa thake. ekati semistara 16 saptahera skula thake. ekati semistare, kimoke klase kata ghanta byaya karate haya?

jani tara gharera mejhete pare thaka khelana tulachhe. se 500ti tukarora lego baksera seta mejhete jaro karechhila, eban anya arekatite 500-tukarora baksera tulanaya 3 guna tukaro chhila, o anya arekatite 1/4 bhaga tukaro chhila. yadi jani samasta lego tule thake tahale kataguli blaka se tulechhila?

marisa 12 maila patha pari dichchhena. eramadhye prathama 4 maila hamtate tini 1 ghanta eban parera dui maila hamtate arao eka ghanta samaya niyechhena. yadi tini chana tamra hamtara gatibega gare prati ghantaya 4 maila habe, tahale abashishta duratba atikrama karara janya tamke kata bege (maila prati ghantaya) hamtate habe?

kyandisa kaphi shape kaje beronora age tamra parse 80ti posta-ita nota rakhena. tamra yaoyara pathe, tini dokane damralena eban eka pyaketa posta-ita nota kinalena; kaje giye tini 220ti alada alada kaphira kapera pratitite ekati kare posta-ita nota rakhalena. yadi tamra kachhe mota 23ti posta-ita nota abashishta thake, tahale tamra kena pyakete kataguli posta-ita nota chhila?

charlira kachhe 10ti stikara chhila. se malera ekati dokana theke 21ti stikara kinechhe eban 23ti stikara tara janmadine peyechhe. tarapara charli tara bonake 9ti stikara diyechhe eban 28ti stikara gritin karda sajanora janya byabahara karechhe. charlira kachhe ara kataguli stikara abashishta thakabe?

kalinda tara mayera sathe 360 ti anshayukta ekati pajala niye khela karachhe. kalinda sadharanata prati minite 4ti tukaro jurate pare. kalinda eka minite yata sankhyaka tukaro jurate pare, tara ma eka minite sadharanata sei parimanera ardheka parena. tadera ei pajelati sampurna karate kata ghanta samaya lagabe?

judi saptahera pratidina 5ti kare o shanibare 8ti kare nachera klasa karena. yadi prati klase 15 jana kare shiksharthi thake o tini prati shiksharthira theke $15.00 kare nena, tabe 1 saptahe tini kata parimana artha uparjana karena?

liuka saikate balira durga tairi kare samaya katachchhena. kramasha tini kheyala karalena ye balira durgera pratiti talara parimapa setira nichera talara bargaphuta parimapera ardheka habe. yadi tini 4 talara balira durga banana yara shirsha talara mapa 16 bargaphuta, tahale ekati talara gara mapa kata bargaphuta?
phuladanitite 4ti golapa achhe. phuladanitite ye kati golapa rayechhe tara theke arao 7ti daliya beshi achhe. ai phuladanitite mota kataguli phula achhe?

phina pukure 11ti byanachike samtara katate dekhena. hathat tini tadera madhye 6tike ekati lili patara arala theke beriye asate dekhalena, tarapara tini tadera madhye 2tike patharera niche lukote dekhena. phina ekhana pukure kataguli byanachi dekhate pabena?
konao ekati nirdishta shaharera 40ti restoramte 200 paunda gajara bitarana kara haya. pratyeka restoram 2 paunda kare gajara grahana kare. kata paunda gajara byabahrita habe na?
janera 10 hektarera ekati anarasera ksheta achhe. prati hektare 100ti anarasa hayechhe. prati 3 mase jana anarasa tolena. jana ekabachharera madhye kataguli anarasa tolena?
